title: Patna Museum - A Treasure House of Bihar’s Glorious Heritage
content:
Patna Museum 

Patna Museum, located in the heart of Patna, Bihar, is one of India’s oldest and most fascinating museums. Established in 1917 during the British era, it showcases the rich history, art, and culture of Bihar through priceless artifacts from ancient to modern times. For history enthusiasts, students, and tourists, Patna Museum is a must-visit destination that beautifully connects the past with the present.

History and Significance

Patna Museum was built to preserve and display archaeological discoveries from the ancient city of Pataliputra and other regions of Bihar. The building itself is an architectural gem - a blend of Mughal and Rajput styles.
The museum houses thousands of rare artifacts, including Mauryan sculptures, Buddhist relics, Mughal paintings, and the world-famous Didarganj Yakshi statue, carved from a single piece of polished sandstone.

Major Attractions

  • Didarganj Yakshi Statue - The pride of Patna Museum, dating back to the Mauryan period.
  • Buddhist Relics - Sacred ashes of Lord Buddha, preserved in a crystal casket.
  • Ancient Coins & Sculptures - Reflecting India’s glorious dynasties.
  • Painting Gallery - Showcasing Mughal and British-era artworks.
  • Natural History Section - Displaying fossils, minerals, and wildlife specimens.

Best Time to Visit

The best time to explore Patna Museum is from October to March, when the weather is pleasant for sightseeing.

Entry Fee and Timings

  • Entry Fee: ₹20 (Indians), ₹250 (Foreigners)
  • Timings: 10:30 AM - 4:30 PM
  • Closed On: Mondays and Public Holidays

How to Reach

  • By Air: Nearest airport - Jay Prakash Narayan International Airport, about 7 km away.
  • By Train: Patna Junction is just 3 km from the museum.
  • By Road: Easily reachable by taxi, auto-rickshaw, or city bus.

Nearby Attractions

  • Golghar - The iconic dome-shaped granary. Read more..
  • Kumhrar Park - Ancient ruins of Pataliputra. Read more..
  • Takht Sri Patna Sahib - Birthplace of Guru Gobind Singh Ji. Read more..
  • Gandhi Maidan - A popular public ground with historical importance.

Why Visit Patna Museum

Patna Museum is a journey through time - from ancient dynasties to modern India. Its vast collection, peaceful ambiance, and educational value make it a perfect destination for travelers interested in history, culture, and art.
